task.description:
Validate that EE-07 (Parallel gateway join) meets all release criteria.

1. Confirm `tests/reports/WF02-ee07-20260522-test-run.json` shows all tests PASS.
2. Verify all 5 EE-07 acceptance criteria are covered by passing test cases.
3. Run `zig build` to confirm the build is clean.
4. Check that `src/engine/transition.zig` has zero I/O (no db calls, no allocations tied to system resources in the join path).
5. Verify the `PARALLEL_JOIN` event schema in the implementation matches the design spec.
6. Write the inner release report to `docs/issue-reports/WF02-ee07-20260522-step-05-release-validator-INNER-REPORT.json`.
7. If all checks pass: set result.status = PASS and recommend EE-07 for RELEASED status.
   If any check fails: set result.status = FAIL with blocking issues listed.
